title: Beggars
description: The only way for players to obtain resources is to beg from creatures through the "begging bowl", completely changing the traditional resource acquisition path.
body:
Beggars Mod — Official Gameplay & Features
Mod Overview
Mod Name: Beggars
Supported Version: Minecraft Java 1.20.1 (Forge 47.x.x)
Author: DY_XiaoJiaZi
Type: Core Survival Overhaul
Core Rule: You can only get resources by begging mobs with a Begging Bowl. No normal resource gathering.
You are a wandering beggar instead of a miner or farmer. The only way to survive is to beg every mob for supplies. Each mob gives different loot.
Core Gameplay
1. Begging Bowl
You get a Begging Bowl in the first inventory slot when you spawn.
The bowl is locked permanently. You cannot move, drop, store or destroy it.
You can only beg mobs while holding this bowl.
2. Begging Method
Sneak and hold right-click at any mob within 6 blocks for 3 full seconds to finish begging.
A blue border and countdown show during charging.
Let go, stand up, move away or kill the mob to cancel begging.
The mob will stare at you for 2 seconds after successful begging.
3. Mob Cooldown Mechanic
Each mob has its own 15-minute cooldown after giving loot. It will refuse to beg again during cooldown.
4. Loot System & Tiers
You get 1–3 item types per successful beg, total 10–30 items.
Loot depends on three factors: mob type, biome, dimension.
50% chance for Bonus Blessing: extra rare loot with tier guarantee system
- 10 common drops = guaranteed rare
- 10 rare drops = guaranteed epic
- 5 epic drops = guaranteed legendary
- 3 legendary drops = guaranteed mythic
5. Villager Job Rewards
Different villagers give different items based on jobs:
- Farmer: Crops, bread, pumpkins
- Librarian: Paper, books
- Weaponsmith: Iron ingots, coal
- Unemployed: Bread & basic crops
20% chance to get diamonds, emeralds or random enchanted books.
6. Special Item Rules
- Enchanted books get random non-curse, non-treasure enchantments.
- Unstackable items (tools, buckets, elytra) always spawn 1 piece.
Survival Rule Changes
- No Crafting Tables: You cannot open crafting tables. Only the 2×2 personal crafting grid works.
- Tools Still Usable: Pickaxes, axes, hoes and shears work normally.
- No Normal Resource Farming: Mining blocks drops nothing. All materials must come from begging.
Full Feature List
Feature
Details
Only Loot Source
All items come from begging
Locked Begging Bowl
Fixed in first slot, cannot be stored
3-second charge
Sneak + hold right-click with UI hints
Mob 15min cooldown
Each mob can only give loot once per cooldown
Dynamic Loot Pool
Loot varies by mob, biome and dimension
Bonus Blessing
50% rare extra drop with tier guarantee
Job-based Villager Loot
Unique rewards from different villagers
Usable Tools
All vanilla tools work as normal
Disabled Crafting Tables
Only 2×2 personal crafting available
Random Enchanted Books
Random valid enchantments on book drops
Unstackable Item Cap
Non-stack items always spawn 1
Target Glow
The mob you beg glows for clear targeting
Bowl Never Lost
Begging bowl stays after death
Compatibility
- Works well with most popular mods (JEI, minimaps, performance mods).
- Right-clicking villagers/traders with the bowl blocks trading to avoid misoperation.
- The bowl cannot be put into any containers or pulled by hoppers.
- All player begging stats save in player NBT data.
Gameplay Tips
1. Early Game: Beg passive mobs (cows, sheep, chickens) for food and basic materials.
2. Mid Game: Travel different biomes for special biome loot.
3. Villager Strategy: Collect different job villagers for unique supplies.
4. Tier Guarantee: Stack common drops to unlock guaranteed high-tier loot.
5. Nether & End: Beg dimension mobs for exclusive dimension items.
Config Settings
All values adjustable via config/beggars-common.toml:
Charging time, mob cooldown, loot quantity, bonus chance, tier thresholds and more.
Conclusion
Beggars mod brings a totally new survival experience. Forget mining and farming — survive only by begging mobs. Every beg brings unexpected surprises.
Mod Name: Beggars
Author: DY_XiaoJiaZi
Version: 1.0.0
Supported Game: Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge 47.x.x
License: All rights reserved
Enjoy your begging journey!
